description: This file is a React component implementing the Mindmap client UI, including view state management, data fetching, debugging tools, and layout for an interactive mind map visualization within a career navigation application.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Utility function to constrain a number within specified min and max bounds.

methods.name: defaultFilters
methods.description: Returns default filter settings for the mind map view.

methods.name: defaultState
methods.description: Initial default state object for the mind map view, including pan, zoom, filters, and selected nodes.

methods.name: toSafeState
methods.description: Sanitizes and converts a raw input object into a valid MindmapViewState with defaults.

methods.name: safeErrorMessage
methods.description: Provides a human-readable error message string from an unknown error, distinguishing API errors and generic errors.

methods.name: getUserKey
methods.description: Generates or retrieves a stable user identifier; uses personaId if available, otherwise creates/stores an anonymous ID in localStorage.

methods.name: computeEmptyStateReason
methods.description: Determines the appropriate UI message when the mind map has no data or encounters loading errors.

methods.name: DebugRow
methods.description: A React component to display key-value debug information rows.
